connection: An out is the unit an outfielder is paid to record, and his surname names the man who records them.
notes: MLB debut 2022 with the Los Angeles Dodgers; National League Rookie of the Month for April 2023. Later with Minnesota and Detroit.

connection: A pitcher is employed to record outs, which is what his surname says.
notes: Pitched for Oakland, Colorado, Cleveland and the Yankees between 2008 and 2014. Oakland fans nicknamed him Out-Man, but the aptronym is the surname, not the nickname.

connection: Said aloud his surname is ball four, the pitch that walks a batter and the last thing a closer wants.
notes: All-Star in 2013; holds the Oakland Athletics record of 44 consecutive saves converted.
